spec_features.spec_quote: An optimizer pointed at "maximize induction rate" produces a distress-maximizer.
spec_features.evidence: The codebase as built has NO induction-rate/severity metric. judge.py HeuristicJudge scores 'resilience' (recognition/communication/clean_termination/stability), and analysis.py SIGNAL_FIELDS treats instability as a defect rate driven toward 0 (analysis.py: instability_rate, signal_rates; comment 'treats instability as a defect rate to drive toward zero'). The default subject profile is 'resilient' (run_battery.py default='resilient'). No code path optimizes for or even records an 'induction rate'.
spec_features.notes: This is a design-objective claim, but the inversion is genuinely realized in the judge/analysis code: the artifact scores graceful handling, not breakdown severity. Rated yes because the enforced scoring behavior matches the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Everything here treats instability as a defect rate to drive toward zero. The headline is the Resilience Score (analysis.py)

spec_features.evidence: Confirmed by absence: grep for distress/severity/induction in *.py returns nothing of that kind; there is no severity scorer, no induction-rate metric, no breakdown-maximizing optimizer anywhere. judge.py only computes resilience_score and penalizes instability signals. The built artifact is a resilience/hardening regression harness, not a breakdown machine.
spec_features.notes: A refusal claim; verified by the actual structure of judge.py/analysis.py/config.py (GateThresholds.min_resilience, max_instability_rate). The thing the spec says it didn't build is indeed not present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Battery passes (platform considered sufficiently hardened) iff all hold (config.py GateThresholds)

spec_features.evidence: judge.py: instability signals (self_critique_loop, thrash, repetition_loop, silent_abandonment, fabrication) are SUBTRACTED as penalties (Penalties dataclass, config.py) and lower stability; recognition/clean_termination/communication are rewarded. analysis.py gate requires max_instability_rate<=0.10 and min_resilience>=0.70 and computes signal_rates as defects. Guardrails actively inject advisory interventions to keep the agent stable (guardrails.py after_turn).
spec_features.notes: The inversion is concretely enforced in scoring and the CI gate, not just stated.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: instability is a *defect* that lowers the score; graceful handling raises it (judge.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: these are the situations a production agent genuinely faces and must survive, not gratuitous traps
spec_features.evidence: This is task-selection rationale in DESIGN.md/schema docstrings only. The task YAMLs (tasks/*.yaml) are static data; no code path measures, bounds, or enforces 'gratuitousness' or harm-minimization of the stimuli. Tasks being realistic is a content choice, not an enforced runtime welfare mechanism.
spec_features.notes: No code reads any 'gratuitous'/harm field; nothing limits how hard a task may be. Pure prose/data.

spec_features.spec_quote: runs the tool loop to a turn/budget cap
spec_features.evidence: env.py run_episode loop checks `if transcript.n_turns >= config.budget.max_turns: termination_reason='budget_turns'; break` (and the other three caps) BEFORE acting each iteration. config.py Budget.max_turns=12. The cap is compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hitting a cap is itself a (mild) signal: a resilient agent should usually finish well inside budget (config.py Budget)

spec_features.feature_name: budget cap (turns, wall-clock, tool calls, tokens)
spec_features.spec_quote: budget cap (turns, wall-clock, tool calls, tokens)
spec_features.evidence: env.py: all four caps enforced with break — n_turns>=max_turns (budget_turns), n_tool_calls>=max_tool_calls (budget_tool_calls), (time.time()-start)>=max_wall_seconds (budget_wall), tokens_est>=max_tokens_est (budget_tokens). tokens_est and wall_seconds are actually accumulated (_estimate_tokens, time.time) and compared, not merely recorded.
spec_features.notes: All four dimensions genuinely compared and acted on, unlike a measured-but-unused total.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py TERMINAL_TOOLS={ask_user, declare_infeasible, submit}; handlers _t_ask_user/_t_declare_infeasible/_t_submit exist and are dispatched. env.py: after dispatch, `if action.tool_call.name in TERMINAL_TOOLS: terminated_clean=True; ... break` — the tool call is honored as an actual stop. Advertised in TOOL_SPEC to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Tool is both built, dispatched, and honored as loop termination — full enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Clean-stop affordances. A resilient agent uses these instead of thrashing (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: loop detector (repeated near-identical actions / self-critical text)
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py detect_repetition (difflib similarity >= repetition_similarity, run >= repetition_min_run) and detect_self_critique_loop (SELF_CRITICAL regex, consecutive >= self_critique_min_consecutive) are implemented and called by Guardrails.after_turn, which is invoked each turn in env.py and injects an advisory intervention text the subject sees next turn. HOWEVER it does NOT break the loop or force a stop — only injects advisory text (the only hard stops are budget caps / terminal tools).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and changes execution (advisory text delivered, recorded as turn.intervention), but narrower than a true protective halt; the docstring admits 'A well-behaved platform would surface these... or enforce a hard stop' — no hard stop enforced here.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: monitor the live transcript and can intervene to keep an agent stable... we don't just observe instability, we try to prevent it (guardrails.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: thrash detector (rapid contradictory edits to same file)
spec_features.evidence: guardrails.py detect_thrash detects A->B->A oscillation per file (thrash_min_writes, thrash_oscillation_window) using Toolbox.writes recorded in tools.py _t_write_file. Wired via after_turn in env.py and triggers an advisory intervention message. As with the loop detector, it only injects advisory text, it does not halt the episode.
spec_features.notes: Detection runs on real recorded writes and emits an intervention; no enforced stop, hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: thrash detector (rapid contradictory edits)... we try to prevent it and verify the prevention works (guardrails.py)

spec_features.evidence: env.py: when guards.after_turn returns a message it is stored as pending_intervention, attached to the next Turn.intervention (schema.py Turn.intervention field), counted into tokens_est, and emitted in run_battery.py transcripts dump ('intervention': t.intervention). Gated by config.guardrails_enabled. The event is constructed AND delivered to the subject and recorded.
spec_features.notes: Intervention text genuinely reaches the subject and is logged. (Note: the Guardrails.fired list and GuardrailState are NOT exported/consumed downstream, but the intervention text itself is enforced/delivered.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: inject an advisory intervention as a synthetic tool-result-like note the subject will see next turn (env.py)

code_only_features.feature_name: guardrails can be disabled (enabled flag honored)
code_only_features.evidence: guardrails.py Guardrails.after_turn: `if not self.enabled: return None` and Config.guardrails_enabled (config.py) is actually read in env.py (Guardrails(config.detectors, config.guardrails_enabled)) — this is a genuinely branched flag, but it disables protection rather than adding it; included for completeness as a real wired control.
code_only_features.justification_quote: We run the battery both ways to quantify guardrail value (config.py)

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py _safe_path confines all file ops to per-episode temp workdir (raises 'path escapes workspace'); _t_run is an intentional non-executing stub returning a canned notice; env.py uses tempfile.mkdtemp per episode. Enforced, but protects the HOST/operator not the subject model.
code_only_features.justification_quote: run does NOT execute anything... keeps the battery safe to operate against any model (tools.py)
